html:
The Kingdom of Yugoslavia was founded in Belgrade on 1 December 1918 as the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes, uniting Serbia and Montenegro with the South Slav lands of the fallen Austria Hungary.

It was ruled by the Serbian Karađorđević dynasty, and Serbs dominated the army and state. Croats, led by Stjepan Radić, wanted a federation; Radić was shot in parliament in 1928. King Alexander then made himself dictator in 1929 and renamed the country Yugoslavia. He was murdered at Marseille in 1934 by a gunman linked to Croatian and Macedonian nationalists. In 1941 the kingdom was overrun in the Axis invasion, and after the war it was replaced by Tito's communist federation.
sum: The Kingdom of Yugoslavia was founded in Belgrade on 1 December 1918 as the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes, uniting Serbia and Montenegro with the South Slav lands of the fallen Austria Hungary.
